notes.title: Will the Polo Bear stand the test of time?
notes.q: What are your thoughts about the Polo bear and will they stand the test of time?
notes.body:
The Polo Bear by Ralph Lauren is actually an iconic and fun take on a character that is now intrinsic to the brand. It originally started as a joke between Ralph and his brother Jerry in 1990, when they were both given Steiff bears by colleagues. They started selling their own iteration of the bear and then transitioned into adding it to t-shirts and sweatshirts, later adding it to knitwear.

I also own a Polo Bear sweater with the Collegiate Bear on it and can attest that it adds whimsy to a classic-styled look. It'll totally stand the test of time so long as the joke is running.

notes.title: Unpopular opinion: the Isabel Marant trend
notes.body:
Have you seen the "Isabel Marant girl" popping up left and right? The hype of this boho chic style?

Our first thoughts on it: it could be beneficial for brand visibility, but you should avoid buying the collections if you are only doing it to buy into the hype of the trend. Leave the collections to the boho-niche girlies and flaunt your own unique style.

Follow along for the pinnacle of the fashion industry and all the excitement it has to offer.

notes.title: Don't judge an outfit by its flatlay
notes.body:
An outfit can look a lot different when it's lying on the ground or hanging in the closet, versus when it's actually worn.

When looking for inspiration, look for outfits that are actually being modeled or that you have a chance to try on.

notes.title: Using Pinterest for outfit inspiration
notes.body:
Create a cluster to determine your color palette. This will form the basis of your outfit and guide you when searching for pieces.

Only save outfits and pieces that are actually being modeled. An outfit will look much different lying flat or hanging versus when it is worn.

notes.title: Don't be into trends
notes.body:
"Don't be into trends. Don't make fashion own you, but you decide what you are, what you want to express by the way you dress and the way to live." Gianni Versace.

Don't be afraid to stand out from the rest and own your unique style.
